Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires, along with the Australian players are out in the middle. KL Rahul and Rohit Sharma are set to open the innings for India. Mitchell Starc has the new ball in hand.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

With Jasprit Bumrah and Mohammed Shami not playing this game, India will be very happy with their bowling effort. Many were surprised with Ashwin's inclusion in the squad but he silenced all those critics in this game though it is a warm-up game. Coming onto bowl the second over, he removed Warner and Marsh in consecutive deliveries and put the Aussies right under pressure. Jadeja then worked his magic by removing Finch on his first delivery. The bowlers did lose some momentum at the end but still will be pleased with their efforts as overall, their bowlers did well collectively. Looks like a chasable total and with the kind of form Ishan Kishan and KL Rahul are in, India should chase it down. Stay tuned for the second essay.

A decent performance with the bat from the Aussies! Warner's form is a big concern for Australia as he got out for a golden duck against New Zealand and got out for just 1 run today. Marsh didn't have the best of the birthdays as he got out for a golden duck. Finch also fell later and Australia found themselves in a spot of bother with 34/3 in the Powerplay. Maxwell and Smith then did some damage control by stitching a 61-run partnership before Maxwell got out. After that, Smith and Stoinis built a partnership of 76 and helped Australia to put 152 on the board.

This is the death over specialist Bhuvneshwar Kumar everyone knows of. Gives away only 6 runs in the last over and picks up a wicket. India will be very pleased to restrict Australia for over just 150. 58 runs came in the last five overs for Australia. They started pretty slow but Smith and Stoinis made sure that they end up putting a defendable total on the board. After their powerful batting performance against England in their first warm-up game, the Men in Blue will feel that they can chase this target as well although, Australia do possess a good bowling line up.
FOUR! A cheeky shot to end the innings from Matthew Wade. Full, on middle, Wade shuffles across and scoops it over short fine leg for a boundary. AUSTRALIA FINISH WITH 152/5!
Matthew Wade walks out.

OUT! CAUGHT! The momentum has shifted yet again in this final over as India are ending on a high and Steven Smith will be disappointed with that. It's an off-paced delivery again and is banged in, outside off. Smith looks to fetch it and pull but ends up toe-ending it towards extra cover. Rohit Sharma is stationed over there and he takes the simplest of catches.
Commentary.Howout: c Rohit Sharma b Bhuvneshwar Kumar

Commentary.Commentary: This is fine death bowling from Kumar. Smith stands outside off again and Kumar bowls a slower one, close to the tramline. Smith looks to swipe across but gets undone by the lack of pace.
Smith shuffles across and Kumar bangs one in outside the off stump. Smith gets a bottom edge down to the keeper.
Brilliant execution of the wide yorker this time from Kumar. Steven Smith can't get any bat on it.
WIDE! Bhuvneshwar Kumar goes for the wide yorker but gets it all wrong. It's way outside the off stump and a wide is signalled.
Full and wide, driven down to long off for one.
A low-dipping full toss, Stoinis eases it down the ground for one. 15 off the over.
Flatter one, around off and this is tapped to short third man. No run taken.
Here comes the wrong 'un. Stoinis drags it from outside off and gets it off the inner half of the bat towards deep mid-wicket for another couple of runs. Stoinis moves into the 40s now.
Excellent running! On middle and this is worked through the mid-wicket region for a couple.

SIX! There's always a risk associated with bowling a spinner at the death. Flighted ball, on middle. Marcus Stoinis swings freely through the line of the ball and clears the boundary right over the bowler's head. Maximum!
FOUR! This one is muscled by Marcus Stoinis. Shortish ball, around off and Stoinis pulls it back past the bowler and the ball races away into the long off fence.
Varun Chakravarthy will bowl the penultimate over.
On off, Smith opens the face of the bat and steers it behind point for another couple. 13 off the over.
FOUR! Pure timing from Steven Smith. Very full and on the stumps, Smith pierces the gap between long on and deep mid-wicket for another boundary. Australia in cruise control at the moment.
Kumar gets the wide yorker in. Smith looks to open the face of the bat and looks to go over the infield on the off side but misses.
Full and wide, driven along the ground to deep point for one.
FOUR! Top shot from Marcus Stoinis! A wide half-volley and Stoinis strokes it through the cover region with grace and picks up a boundary.
A length ball, well outside off. Stoinis cuts it behind point and picks up a couple of runs.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar (2-0-8-0) is back into the attack.
FIFTY for Steven Smith! This has been a fighting knock from him. On the pads and flicked towards deep square leg for a couple.

FOUR! Steven Smith is now just toying with the field. Thakur bangs in a really slower one, outside off. Smith has all the time in the world and he picks his spot perfectly. Smith gets on top of the bounce and guides it over backward point for yet another boundary. Moves to 49 with that shot.
FOUR! Poor delivery, right in the slot and Steven Smith isn't going to miss out on that one. Smith thumps it right back past the bowler and picks up another boundary.
FOUR! Slower delivery, wide of off stump. Steven Smith waits for it and then drives it beautifully through the cover region for a boundary.
On top of off and muscled down the ground for another single.
Good-length ball, pushed wider. Smith looks to slash but mistimes it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Darted on the pads, flicked to the square leg region for a single.
An inside edge onto the pads as Smith looks to defend it on the off side.
Short again, outside off. Stoinis cuts it to sweeper cover. Just a single.
Short ball, on off. Smith plays it to long on for a single.
A googly now, on middle. Stoinis hits it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Stoinis welcomes Varun Chakravarthy with a boundary! A full ball, around off, was slower in pace and gives an ample amount of time for Stoinis to reverse sweep it to the third man fence.
Varun Chakravarthy is brought into the attack.
Full and on off. Stoinis steps across and works it down to long on for a single.
Now a classic cover drive but only for a single. The fielder there scores a direct hit at the keeper's end but the batter was well in.
FOUR! Nicely played! A slower bouncer from Thakur and Smith waits for it before smashing it over mid off for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Marcus Stoinis pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A wide yorker this time. Marcus Stoinis leaves it alone.
A length ball, on middle and this is heaved down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Shardul Thakur comes back on now.
Flatter, quicker and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up, on off, pushed down to long off for a single.
Loopy ball, on middle. Marcus Stoinis turns it to the mid-wicket region for a single.
On middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
Slightly short, around the leg stump, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter ball, on off. Smith knocks it to sweeper cover for a single.
Ravichandran Ashwin comes into the attack. He is on a hat-trick.
Full ball, outside off. Smith pushes it to covers for one.
A full toss, outside off. Stoinis drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! A short ball, on middle. Stoinis hangs back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full and on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Another full ball, outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
A full ball, outside off, just inside the tramline. Left alone.
Virat Kohli (1-0-4-0) is back into the attack.
Change.
Outside off, worked to long on for one. Stoinis gets off the mark straigthaway.
Marcus Stoinis is the new man in.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Rahul Chahar gets rid of the dangerous Glenn Maxwell. Slower through the air, outside off. Glenn Maxwell fetches that one and looks to sweep it on the leg side. He ends up chopping it back onto the stumps. He is not happy with himself as he walks back to the pavilion.
Outside off, Glenn Maxwell this time tries to reverse sweep but again fails to connect.
Floats it up, outside off. Glenn Maxwell looks to sweep it on the leg side but misses.
Short and outside off, knocked to extra cover off the back foot.
FOUR! Glenn Maxwell is looking to up the ante now! Loopy ball, on middle. Glenn Maxwell reverse-sweeps it towards the third man region for a boundary. Third boundary in the last 4 deliveries.
On middle, nudged to deep mid-wicket for a singe. A good over for Australia. 11 runs from it.
FOUR! Two in a row! Full and outside off, Glenn Maxwell smashes it with the turn over extra cover. Fetches himself another boundary.
FOUR! Well played! Flatter ball, around off. Glenn Maxwell gets down on one knee and slogs it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Loopy ball, on off. Smith cuts it towards backward point. Virat Kohli dives to his left and stops the ball from racing away. Keeps it to just a single.
Flatter ball, on leg. Glenn Maxwell gets low and looks to slog. The ball goes off the lower half of his bat to deep square leg for a single.
Short and on middle, Maxwell mistimes his pull to mid-wicket.

DRINKS! Australia were rocked early as they lost their top-order in the first four overs. Since then, Steven Smith and Glenn Maxwell have occupied the crease and have steered the ship a bit but they do need to get a move on at the earliest. The Indian spinners have bowled exceptionally well as Ravichandran Ashwin and Ravindra Jadeja got wickets and even the other bowlers have kept things tight so far. Also, in another warm-up game, between England and New Zealand, England are 72/2 in 10 overs.
Flatter and quicker, on off. Smith pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, outside off. Maxwell slashes it towards sweeper cover. He crosses ends.
Full and around off, Smith bunts it down to long on for a single.
Short and outside off, cut away to deep point for a run.
Tosses it up, on middle. Smith works it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Chahar floats it up, on off. Steven Smith paddle-scoops it over the keeper's head. The ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Full and on leg, Smith works it to long on for one.
Flatter ball, on middle. Glenn Maxwell makes room and cuts it through cover-point for a single.
This is eased downn to long off for a single.
Flatter ball, on middle. Steven Smith nudges it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Steven Smith makes room for himself and cuts it through backward point. The fielder there misfields and allows the ball to go through his legs. A boundary.
Loopy ball, attacking the stumps. Steven Smith knocks it back to the bowler.

Nicely tossed up, around off. Smith leans forward and drives it uppishly towards long on for a single. The boundaries have almost completely dried up for Australia and they will look to step on the gas now.
Flatter one, around middle. Maxwell heaves it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, outside off. Maxwell looks to cover drive but gets beaten.
On off and eased down the ground for a single.
Smith tries to be cheeky but it doesn't come off. Pushed through quicker, around off, Smith looks to scoop but misses it completely.
Dragged down, around off. Glenn Maxwell rocks back and pulls it to long on for a run.
Rahul Chahar to operate now.
Slower delivery, on the pads. Maxwell works it to deep square leg and picks up another single.
Fullish ball, around off. Smith opens the face of the bat and drives it through cover-point for a single.
Length, on middle and heaved to deep mid-wicket for yet another one.
Fullish ball, around off. Smith drives it on the off side for a single.
Slanted in at middle and Smith keeps it out.
Kohli starts off with a full and wide one, just inside the tramline. Left alone by Smith.
Virat Kohli is brought into the attack now.
Flighted ball, on off. Smith eases it through the cover region for a single. Australia are 34/3 at the end of the Powerplay.
A touch shorter, around off. Maxwell makes room and cuts it to deep point for another one.
Flatter one, around off and worked to sweeper cover for a run.
On off and Glenn Maxwell reverse-sweeps it through covers. Ravichandran Ashwin gives it a chase and cuts it off. The batters do come back for the third. Good running.
FOUR! Edgy boundary but Maxwell won't mind. Slowed up, on off and Maxwell looks to work it through point but edges it past first slip and the ball races away into the fence.
FOUR! Glenn Maxwell executes the switch hit perfectly. Fired in, on middle and Maxwell gets it through cover-point for a boundary.
A length ball, on middle and Smith flicks it towards mid-wicket. He wants the single but is sent back and rightly so.
On off and nicely stroked through covers for a couple by Smith.
A slower bouncer now, around off. Maxwell stays back and dabs it down towards third man for a single.

On the pads and Maxwell whips it through square leg. The ball is racing away but Suryakumar Yadav runs across from fine leg and cuts it off. Steven Smith wants the third but has to settle for a couple.
Fullish ball, on middle and nudged to mid on.
Length again, around off. Maxwell pushes it off the inner half of the bat towards mid on.
WIDE! Thakur starts off with a length ball, way outside off. Left alone and wide signalled.

Shardul Thakur is introduced into the attack now. He replaces Bhuvneshwar Kumar. There's a little bit of issue with the sightscreen. The umpires are still addressing the issue. Meanwhile, Dhoni and Pant can be seen practicing some glovework at the touchline. All sorted now, and we are ready to resume.
Full again and on off. Smith pushes it to covers.
Full and on middle, hit back to the bowler.
Short and on off. Smith punches off the back foot, wide of covers and takes an easy couple.
Full and on off, pushed through covers for a single.
A flatter ball, outside off. Glenn Maxwell looks to push but misses.
Glenn Maxwell walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Another one bites the dust and spinners are doing the magic for India! A tossed up ball, angling around middle and off. Finch lunges to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. Australia 3 down in no time.
Ravindra Jadeja comes into the attack. He replaces Ravichandran Ashwin.
Slightly full, on middle. Smith swivels across and works it to mid-wicket.
A length ball, on off. Finch taps it to covers for a quick single.
On middle, on a length, tucked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! First boundary of the day, coming from the bat of captain Finch! A full ball, on off. Aaron Finch drives it wide of mid on for a boundary.
Mild appeal for LBW but not given! A length ball, angling on the pads. Finch misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
A length ball, on off. Finch steps across and defends it out.
Steven Smith is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two in two for Ravichandran Ashwin and Mitchell Marsh goes for a golden duck on his birthday. Ashwin serves a flatter ball, and angles it around off. Mitchell Marsh prods and looks to defend but gets a thick outside edge to first slip where Rohit Sharma takes a good low catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Rohit Sharma b Ravichandran Ashwin

Commentary.Commentary: Mitchell Marsh walks out to bat at No.3.

OUT! LBW! First blood to India! This was full and angling on middle. David Warner goes for the reverse sweep and fails to execute it and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW by Ashwin and up goes the finger.
A loopy ball, on middle. Finch turns it on the leg side for one more.
Comes around the wicket now. tossed up, on middle. Warner nudges it to square leg for a single.
Darted on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Good fielding! A flatter ball, outside off. Finch cuts it to the right of point where Ravindra Jadeja dives and stops it.
Ravichandran Ashwin to bowl from the opposite end.
Around off, on a length, pushed to point.
BEATEN! A length ball, outside off. Warner looks to push but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length, on off. Finch skips down and punches it to covers for a single.
TWO WIDES! Australia are underway! A length ball, spilled sown the leg side. Warner misses his flick. Kishan fails to grab it clearly and allows the batter to take a single.
Darts it on the pads, flicked to square leg.
Another length ball, around off. Warner taps it to point.
Good delivery! Starts with a length ball, slanting outside off. Warner watchfully leaves it alone.

We are set to begin! The Indian players stride out to the middle. Well Rohit Sharma mentioned during the toss, Virat Kohli is resting in this game but he can be seen fielding for his side. Is he the sixth bowling option Rohit Sharma was mentioning about? Anyway, Ishan Kishan will be taking the gloves for this game. Aaron Finch and David Warner will open the innings for Australia. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to start the proceedings with the ball.

The Indian captain, Rohit Sharma says that, Kohli, Bumrah and Shami are resting. Mentions that they also wanted to try and bat first and put runs on the board. Adds that they want to make sure that they get their sixth bowling option. Tells that they want their bowlers to come and chip in with wickets. Tells that they have got quality in their five bowlers but on a bad day, it is always nice to have that sixth bowling option. On Hardik Pandya, he says that he hasn't started bowling yet, but he will be back before the tournament begins.

The Aussie skipper, Aaron Finch says that, they will have a bat first and it looks like a dry wicket and they did chase in the last game so it's good to mix it up. Adds that he is fit and has recovered well from the surgery. Mentions that Josh Hazlewood played game after game in the Indian T20 League and hence won't be playing today. Mentions that there are also a couple of other changes in the side.

India - KL Rahul, Rohit Sharma(C), Ishan Kishan, Rishabh Pant(WK), Suryakumar Yadav, Hardik Pandya, Ravindra Jadeja, Ravichandran Ashwin, Rahul Chahar, Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Shardul Thakur, Varun Chakravarthy.
Australia - David Warner, Aaron Finch(C), Mitchell Marsh, Steven Smith, Marcus Stoinis, Matthew Wade(WK), Ashton Agar, Mitchell Starc, Kane Richardson, Adam Zampa, Glenn Maxwell, Pat Cummins.
TOSS - Australia have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first.

Unlike India, the Australian bowlers performed much better but it was their batting that let them down. Kane Richardson and Adam Zampa were the shining light with the ball. The form of David Warner remains to be a huge question mark and apart from him all the batters got starts and got into the twenties before throwing their wickets away. If Finch and Warner can get going in this match then the Aussies will look like a very well balanced team heading into the main draw of the tournament. Who needs this win more, India or Australia? Who will head into the tournament with sky-high confidence? We'll find out soon. The toss and team news in a bit.

The openers for India, Ishan Kishan and KL Rahul were on song in the first match as both of them brought up quickfire half-centuries. The middle order too showed some promise. Mohammad Shami was the pick of the bowlers as he scalped 3 wickets but Bhuvneshwar Kumar really struggled and that is a concerning factor for India. The Indians will be hoping to improve their bowling performance on the whole and go into the tournament with another win.

Hello and welcome to another round of warm-up matches before the start of the T20 World Cup. In today's match, two stalwarts of cricket go head-to-head as India take on Australia. Both teams had winning starts but the wins themselves came in contrasting fashions. India chased down a mammoth total with the utmost ease against England, whereas the tailenders were the saving grace for Australia against neighbours New Zealand. Both teams will be pumped up for today's match and even if it's just a warm-up match, we expect a lot of fireworks today from both these sides.
... WARM UP TIME ...
